description: The connected X account's X CHAT conversations: id (group ids start with g), type, muted, disappearing-message timer, screenshot controls, admins, members, PENDING join requests, which actions are admin-only, and the active invite link. X Chat is END-TO-END ENCRYPTED, so message text and group names cannot be read here (list_x_dms reads the plain direct-message history). A filtered page can be short or empty while more remain: keep paging with the same filters. view 'admin_requests' (id = a group the brand admins) lists who asked to become an admin; view 'invite' (inviteLink, or id + inviteToken) previews an invite link: group name, member count, whether the brand is in it. view 'message_requests' lists the MESSAGE REQUESTS waiting outside the inbox (inbox 'priority', the default, or 'low_quality' for X's filtered tab): who sent each one (@handle, name, followers, verified), which accounts the brand follows also follow them, and whether they changed their name or picture recently (X's impersonation hint). A message sent in X Chat is encrypted and cannot be read; one sent as a plain direct message can, with list_x_dms participantId = the sender. Show that to the user before manage_x_chat accept_request. withMembers:true resolves member @handles, and each user X returns is billed. Read-only. Billed per conversation or request returned, plus one user lookup per request sender, so keep maxResults small. Needs X connected with direct-message access: an X connection made before 2026-08-25 must be reconnected once under Workspace > Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

endTime.description: latest message before this ISO 8601 time

id.description: one conversation; for admin_requests, the group (g + digits)

inbox.description: message_requests: X's Priority tab (default) or the filtered low-quality one

inviteLink.description: an x.com/i/chat/group_join/... link, for view invite

inviteToken.description: the 10-character token, with id, for view invite

isArchived.description: true only archived, false only not archived

isMuted.description: true only muted, false only not muted

maxResults.description: 1-100 (message_requests 1-50), default 10; every conversation or request returned is billed

participantIds.description: 1-10 numeric X account ids, comma-separated, all in the chat

startTime.description: latest message at or after this ISO 8601 time

withSenders.description: message_requests: resolve who sent each request (default true, each sender billed)

name: list_x_chats
title: List X Chat conversations
